questions.prompt: What does accessing `(Get-Acl path).Access` return in PowerShell?

options.a: The Access Control Entries (ACEs) — detailing each identity, its rights, and allow/deny status
options.c: The file's creation and modification timestamps

questions.prompt: Which ACL right, when granted to `BUILTIN\Users` on a SYSTEM service executable, represents a privilege escalation path?
What happens when `Set-Acl` with Windows ACE security descriptors is executed on pwsh 7 on Linux?

options.a: It fails or produces limited POSIX-only results because Windows ACL security descriptors are Windows-only
options.b: It modifies Windows Active Directory permissions over the network
options.c: It automatically converts Windows DACLs into Linux sudoers entries
